questions.question: The Least Common Multiple and Highest Common Factor of two numbers are 75 and 5 respectively. If their difference is 10, then what will be the sum of these two numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The Least Common Multiple (LCM) = 75

Highest Common Factor (HCF) = 5

Difference between LCM and HCF = 10

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = Product of their LCM and HCF

(a + b)² = (a – b)² + 4ab

**Calculations:**

Let the two numbers be a and b.

⇒ a × b = 5 × 75

⇒ a × b = 375

∵ a – b = 10

Also, (a + b)² = (a – b)² + 4ab

⇒ (a + b)² = (10)² + 4(375)

⇒ (a + b)² = 100 + 1500

⇒ (a + b)² = 1600

⇒ (a + b) = 40

Therefore, Sum of the two numbers = 40.

questions.question: An article is sold for Rs. 5845 after giving discount of 12.5%. What is the marked price of article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount percentage = 12.5%.

Selling Price = Rs. 5845

**Calculations:**

Let the marked price of the article be Rs. 100x

⇒ Discount = 12.5% × 100x = Rs. 12.5x

⇒ Selling Price = Rs. 100x - Rs. 12.5x = Rs. 87.5x

⇒ 5845 = 87.5x

⇒ x = 5845/87.5 = 66.8

⇒ Marked price = Rs. 100 × (66.8) = Rs. 6680

∴ The marked price of article is Rs. 6680

questions.question: A sum becomes 8 times of itself in 7 years at the rate of compound interest (interest is compounded annually). In how many years will the sum becomes 4096 times of itself?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Principal = Rs. P

Rate of interest = R%

Time = t years

Amount after 7 years = Rs. 8P

**Formula used:**

Amount = (P) × (1 + (R/100))T

**Calculation :**

**According to question,**

⇒ P(1 + (R/100))⁷ = 8P

⇒ (1 + (R/100))⁷ = 8

⇒ 1 + (R/100) = 8¹/⁷ --- (1)

Let Amount after T years be Rs. 4096P

⇒ P(1 + (R/100))T = 4096P

⇒ (1 + (R/100))T = 4096

Substituting (1) in above equation

⇒ (8¹/⁷)T = 8⁴

⇒ (8T/⁷) = 8⁴

⇒ T/7 = 4

⇒ T = 28

**∴ In 28 years, the given principal will become 4096 times of itself.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 12500 gives interest of Rs. 5625 in T years at simple interest. If the rate of interest is 7.5%, then what will be the value of T?
questions.solution:

Principal = Rs. 12500

Rate of Interest = 7.5%

(S.I) = Rs. 5625

**FORMULA USED:**

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

**CALCULATION:**

Simple interest = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 5625 = (12500 × 7.5 × T)/100

⇒ T = 6 years

questions.question: 16 workers working 8 hours per day can demolish a building in 32 days. In how many days 24 workers working 12 hours per day can demolish the same building?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

16 worker workers working 8 hours per day can demolish a building in 32 days.

**Formula used:**

(M × D × H)/W = constant

Where,

M = number of workers

D = number of days

H = number of hours

W = work done

**Calculation:**

Let 24 workers working 12 hours per day can demolish the same building in x days

According to formula,

16 × 8 × 32/(1) = 24 × 12 × x/(1)

⇒ 9x = 4 × 32

⇒ x = 128/9

∴ Number of days required to complete the work is 128/9 days.

questions.question: The volume of a right circular cone is equal to the volume of that right circular cylinder whose height is 48 cm and diameter of its base is 20 cm. If the height of the cone is 16 cm, then what will be the diameter of its base?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of the cylinder = 48 cm

Diameter of the cylinder = 20 cm

Radius of the cylinder = 20/2 = 10 cm

Height of the cone = 16 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of the cylinder = π × r² × H

Volume of the cone = 1/3 × π × r² × h

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f554c24844141db7aad25455f8764b1d71109ed67b4ccf7a47c75e1571b8a0bd.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc0359055e9ce32434848a1f414e4bb8383fd4e9c5858d3cf42363ecb081fb81.png] 

Let the radius of the cone = r cm 

According to the Question,

Volume of the cone = Volume of the cylinder

⇒ 1/3 × π × r² × h = π × r² × H

⇒ 1/3 × π × r² × 16 = π × 10² × 48

⇒ r² = 10² × 3²

⇒ r = 30

**∴ The Diameter of the base of the cone = 2 × 30 = 60 cm.**

questions.solution:

Total time taken in making one car = 1200 hours

Time taken in J3 = 20% of 1200

Time taken in J6 = 16% of 1200

Time taken in J7 = 12% of 1200

A train is moving with a uniform speed. Train crosses a bridge of length 340 meters in 35 seconds and a bridge of length 460 meters in 38 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train = L m

Length of the first Bridge = 340 m

Time taken to cross first Bridge = 35 seconds

Length of the Second Bridge = 460 m

Time taken to cross second Bridge = 38 seconds

**Concept:**

When a train crosses a bridge, it travels a distance equal to its own length and the length of the bridge.

**Common mistake:**

These types of questions, the conversion of speed in meter/seconds into Km/hr should be done carefully.

Unit conversion from Km/hr to m/s, then multiply from 5/18.

Unit conversion from m/s to Km/hr, then multiply from 18/5.

**FORMULA USED:**

Speed = (Distance)/(Time)

**CALCULATION :**

The train crosses First bridge in 35 sec,

∵ Length of train + Length of First bridge = L + 340

⇒ Speed of train = (L + 340)/(35)

The train crosses Second bridge in 38 sec,

∵ Length of train + Length of Second bridge = L + 460

⇒ Speed of train = (L + 460)/(38)

According to Question,

Speed of train will be same

(L + 340)/(35) = (L + 460)/(38)

On solving we get,

⇒ Length of train, L = 1060 m

⇒ Speed of train = (1060 + 340)/(35)

⇒ Speed of train = (1400)/(35) = 40 m/s

⇒ Speed of train = 40 × 18/5 = 144 Km/hr

questions.question: The average daily rainfall of town A is 105 for first 2 days of the week, 84 for next 3 days and 49 for the last 2 days of the week. The total weekly rainfall for town B is 455. What will be the average daily rainfall of both the towns together?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Total rainfall for Town B = 455

Average daily rainfall for first 2 days = 105

Total rainfall for first 2 days = 210

Average daily rainfall for next 3 days = 84

Total rainfall for next 3 days = 252

Average daily rainfall for last 2 days = 49

Total rainfall for last 2 days = 98

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of all quantities/Total number of quantities

**Calculations :**

⇒ Total rainfall for Town A = 210 + 252 + 98 = 560

⇒ Average daily rainfall for Town A and B together = (560 + 455)/7

⇒ Average daily rainfall for Town A and B together = 1015/7

⇒ Average daily rainfall for Town A and B together = 145

∴ the average daily rainfall of both the towns together is 145.
